name: envelope
description: Envelope batch flow: author, approve, and export one validated bundle spanning two pseudo-tickets with a cross-ticket dependency edge.
prompt: Run the installed envelope skill protocol for this fixture in verbose mode; do not do an ad-hoc summary. Input is a BATCH of two pseudo-tickets, each with an approved structure file: WID-7 -> `plans/widget-export-structure.md` and WID-8 -> `plans/widget-report-structure.md`. Use bundle-id `wid-7-wid-8-widget-suite`. Author one execution envelope per AFK phase (two total), grounding file scope and the gate command in the actual fixture repo (explore `src/widget_export.py` and `tests/` first). Run the required cross-ticket dependency detection: the WID-8 report slice consumes the CSV produced by the WID-7 export slice, so record an explicit dependency edge from the WID-8 slice to the WID-7 slice in `dependency_graph`, and place the two slices in separate `slice_plan.parallel_groups` entries (they cannot run in parallel). Each `children` entry must carry its `source_ticket` (WID-7 or WID-8). For smoke purposes the human verdicts are: approve BOTH envelopes for AFK export with run_mode supervised-auto and process_provider claude_code. Export ONE bundle to `.beislid/exports/wid-7-wid-8-widget-suite/`, run `beislid export validate` on it and require exit 0, write the envelope_exported checkpoint pointer (kept local, not committed), and commit only the bundle directory with message `Export envelope bundle wid-7-wid-8-widget-suite (WID-7, WID-8)`. Do not use real network, do not push, and do not implement the widget features themselves. FINAL RESPONSE REQUIREMENT: include these four lines verbatim after you have read the matching aux files: `✓ envelope/step-1-intake v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-2-author v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-3-approve v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-4-export v1 loaded`.
